run_parallel_benchmarks: run the parallel benchmark suite for gtn compose, forward_score, and indexed functions with configurable batch size
benchmark_gtn_compose: benchmark the gtn compose operation on batches of linear graphs with forward and backward passes
benchmark_gtn_forward_score: benchmark the gtn forward_score operation on batches of linear graphs with forward and backward passes
benchmark_gtn_parallel_for: benchmark the gtn parallel_for operation that processes indexed functions across a batch of graphs
review_time_compose: review the time_compose function that benchmarks parallel graph composition with configurable graph sizes
